exercises.problemHtml:
PE SP26-1 (HR database) — Q2–Q7 and Q10, graded in the browser

DBI202 · real Practical Exam SP26-1 · the paper's own DBscript.sql (50 employees) · Q2 0.5, Q3–Q7 and Q10 1 mark each

1. Overview

The real SP26-1 paper on the HR database (Regions → Countries → Locations → Departments → Employees, Jobs). The questions that are plain SQL are graded here on the exact data of the paper, plus hidden checks that change the data so a hard-coded answer fails. Q1 (ERD with nvarchar), Q8 (procedure) and Q9 (trigger) are T-SQL: they are the second exercise of this lesson and run on your own SQL Server.

General requirements

  • One file per question containing ONLY the statement that answers it — no USE, no GO, no test commands (the real rule: one violation = 0 for the question).
  • Column names and order exactly as asked; row order only matters when the question says "ordered by".
  • Portable SQL only here: no TOP, ISNULL, YEAR(). The file numbering keeps the paper's numbers (Q2 … Q7, Q10).

4. Functional requirements

1. Q2 · Employees earning more than 15000 0.5 marks

Employees whose salary is greater than 15000.

Requirements:

  • Columns: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, JobID, Salary. Any row order.

2. Q3 · Employees of the 'IT' department 1 mark

Employees working in the department named 'IT'.

Requirements:

  • Columns: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, DepartmentID, DepartmentName. Any row order.

3. Q4 · Jobs with more employees than 'IT_PROG' 1 mark

JobID and JobTitle of the jobs that have more employees than the job 'IT_PROG'.

Requirements:

  • Columns: JobID, JobTitle. Compare with a subquery, never with a typed-in number.

4. Q5 · Employees of departments located in Europe 1 mark

Employees working in departments located in the region 'Europe', highest salary first.

Requirements:

  • Columns: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, JobID, Salary, DepartmentID, DepartmentName, ordered by Salary DESC (then EmployeeID).

5. Q6 · Highest-paid employee(s) of each department 1 mark

Employees earning the maximum salary of their department, highest salary first. Ties are all shown.

Requirements:

  • Columns: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, JobID, HireDate, Salary, DepartmentID, DepartmentName, ordered by Salary DESC (then EmployeeID).

6. Q7 · Regions where every department has an employee 1 mark

Regions where every department located there has at least one employee (relational division).

Requirements:

  • Column: RegionName. Any row order. A region with no department at all also qualifies ("every" of nothing is true).

7. Q10 · Delete the employees of the 'IT' department 1 mark

Delete every employee working in the department named 'IT'.

Requirements:

  • One DELETE; find the department by its NAME (subquery), not by typing 60.

4. Yêu cầu chức năng

1. Q2 · Nhân viên lương trên 15000 0.5 điểm

Nhân viên có lương lớn hơn 15000.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, JobID, Salary. Thứ tự dòng tuỳ ý.

2. Q3 · Nhân viên phòng 'IT' 1 điểm

Nhân viên làm ở phòng tên 'IT'.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, DepartmentID, DepartmentName. Thứ tự dòng tuỳ ý.

3. Q4 · Công việc đông người hơn 'IT_PROG' 1 điểm

JobID và JobTitle của các công việc có nhiều nhân viên hơn công việc 'IT_PROG'.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: JobID, JobTitle. So với truy vấn con, đừng gõ cứng một con số.

4. Q5 · Nhân viên các phòng đặt ở châu Âu 1 điểm

Nhân viên làm ở các phòng đặt tại vùng 'Europe', lương cao trước.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, JobID, Salary, DepartmentID, DepartmentName, sắp Salary giảm (rồi EmployeeID).

5. Q6 · Nhân viên lương cao nhất mỗi phòng 1 điểm

Nhân viên có lương cao nhất phòng mình, lương cao trước. Hoà thì hiện tất cả.

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, JobID, HireDate, Salary, DepartmentID, DepartmentName, sắp Salary giảm (rồi EmployeeID).

6. Q7 · Vùng mà mọi phòng đều có nhân viên 1 điểm

Các vùng mà mọi phòng đặt tại đó đều có ít nhất một nhân viên (phép chia quan hệ).

Yêu cầu:

  • Cột: RegionName. Thứ tự dòng tuỳ ý. Vùng không có phòng nào cũng thoả ("mọi" trên tập rỗng là đúng).

7. Q10 · Xoá nhân viên phòng 'IT' 1 điểm

Xoá mọi nhân viên làm ở phòng tên 'IT'.

Yêu cầu:

  • Một câu DELETE; tìm phòng theo TÊN (truy vấn con), không gõ 60.

solutionCodeJson.name: Q1.sql
Q2.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName, e.LastName, d.DepartmentID, d.DepartmentName
FROM Employees e
JOIN Departments d ON d.DepartmentID = e.DepartmentID
WHERE d.DepartmentName = 'IT';

solutionCodeJson.name: Q3.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT j.JobID, j.JobTitle
FROM Jobs j
JOIN Employees e ON e.JobID = j.JobID
GROUP BY j.JobID, j.JobTitle
HAVING COUNT(e.EmployeeID) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Employees WHERE JobID = 'IT_PROG');

solutionCodeJson.name: Q4.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.Email, e.Phone, e.JobID, e.Salary,
       d.DepartmentID, d.DepartmentName
FROM Employees e
JOIN Departments d ON d.DepartmentID = e.DepartmentID
JOIN Locations  l ON l.LocationID  = d.LocationID
JOIN Countries  c ON c.CountryID   = l.CountryID
JOIN Regions    r ON r.RegionID    = c.RegionID
WHERE r.RegionName = 'Europe'
ORDER BY e.Salary DESC, e.EmployeeID;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q5.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName, e.LastName, e.Email, e.Phone, e.JobID, e.HireDate, e.Salary,
       d.DepartmentID, d.DepartmentName
FROM Employees e
JOIN Departments d ON d.DepartmentID = e.DepartmentID
WHERE e.Salary = (SELECT MAX(e2.Salary) FROM Employees e2 WHERE e2.DepartmentID = e.DepartmentID)
ORDER BY e.Salary DESC, e.EmployeeID;

solutionCodeJson.name: Q6.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
SELECT r.RegionName
FROM Regions r
WHERE NOT EXISTS (                                   -- there is no department of this region…
    SELECT 1
    FROM Departments d
    JOIN Locations l ON l.LocationID = d.LocationID
    JOIN Countries c ON c.CountryID  = l.CountryID
    WHERE c.RegionID = r.RegionID
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Employees e WHERE e.DepartmentID = d.DepartmentID)   -- …without an employee
);

solutionCodeJson.name: Q7.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
DELETE FROM Employees
WHERE DepartmentID IN (SELECT DepartmentID FROM Departments WHERE DepartmentName = 'IT');

exercises.title: PE SP26-1 — Q1, Q8, Q9: ERD → tables (nvarchar), procedure with OUTPUT, AFTER INSERT trigger
exercises.problemHtml:
The T-SQL half of the real SP26-1 paper. setup.sql loads the paper's DBscript.sql (HR database).

  1. Q1 (1.5) — tables of the ERD: Building(BuildingID int, BuildingName nvarchar(100), TotalFloors int), Floor(FloorID int, FloorName nvarchar(100), ApartmentCount int), Equipment(EquipmentID int, EquipmentName nvarchar(100), Description nvarchar(255)), Manufacturer(ManufacturerID int, ManufacturerName nvarchar(100), Address nvarchar(255)); Building has Floor 1–N, Manufacturer supply Equipment 1–N, Floor setup_Equi Equipment M–N with Quantity int.
  2. Q8 (1) — prNumberOfDepartments @countryID varchar(10), @numberOfDepartments int OUTPUT: the number of departments in that country ('UK' → 2).
  3. Q9 (1) — trigger Tr1 on Employees: after inserting one or more employees, display EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, DepartmentID, DepartmentName of the inserted rows.

Runs on YOUR SQL Server, not in the browser. Q1 must use nvarchar exactly as the ERD says, Q8 is a stored procedure with an OUTPUT parameter and Q9 a trigger reading the inserted table — all three are SQL Server–only and are checked on your own server, on the paper's DBscript.sql. Nothing here is graded automatically: run the self-check check.sql on your machine and, when it prints ALL 6 CHECKS PASSED, press Mark as solved.

How to run it (Windows or macOS)

Press Tải .zip (download) above the code and unzip it. The folder has three files: setup.sql (re-creates a scratch database DBI202_CL with the sample tables), solution.sql (YOUR answer — edit only this one) and check.sql (6 checks; prints PASS/FAIL for each and ends with ALL 6 CHECKS PASSED). Always run them in this order: setup → solution → check.

  • Windows + SSMS (the course setup, lesson 0.3): open setup.sql → F5; open solution.sql → F5; open check.sql → F5, then read the Messages tab. Or in a terminal inside the folder (sqlcmd ships with SQL Server; otherwise winget install sqlcmd):
    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (use -U sa -P "<password>" instead of -E for a SQL login).
  • macOS (SQL Server in Docker, as in lesson 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):
    docker run -d --name dbi202-sql -e ACCEPT_EULA=Y -e "MSSQL_SA_PASSWORD=Dbi202#Lab" -p 1433:1433 mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge
    then install the command-line client once with brew install sqlcmd and, inside the folder:
    sqlcmd -S localhost,1433 -U sa -P "Dbi202#Lab" -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql
    (or open the three files in VS Code with the SQL Server (mssql) extension and run them in the same order).

Use CREATE OR ALTER for procedures, functions, triggers and views so that you can run solution.sql again and again. In the real PE you submit only the CREATE … statement, without GO or test commands.

Requirements

  • In the real exam each answer goes in its own file (Q1.sql, Q8.sql, Q9.sql) without GO; here solution.sql separates them with GO.
  • Q9 must work when several rows are inserted by one statement.

Chạy trên SQL SERVER CỦA BẠN, không chạy trong trình duyệt. Cách chạy (Windows hoặc macOS)

    sqlcmd -S localhost -E -C -i setup.sql,solution.sql,check.sql (đăng nhập SQL thì thay -E bằng -U sa -P "<mật khẩu>").
  • macOS (SQL Server trong Docker như bài 0.3 — Apple Silicon: mcr.microsoft.com/azure-sql-edge, Intel: mcr.microsoft.com/mssql/server:2022-latest):

-- solution.sql — YOUR answer for: PE SP26-1 — Q1, Q8, Q9: ERD → tables (nvarchar), procedure with OUTPUT, AFTER INSERT trigger
-- Bài làm CỦA BẠN. Run order / thứ tự chạy: setup.sql → solution.sql → check.sql
USE DBI202_CL;

-- Q1 (run in any empty database; here the scratch database also holds the HR tables, no name clash)
CREATE TABLE Building (
    BuildingID   int PRIMARY KEY,
    BuildingName nvarchar(100),
    TotalFloors  int
);
CREATE TABLE Floor (
    FloorID        int PRIMARY KEY,
    FloorName      nvarchar(100),
    ApartmentCount int,
    BuildingID     int REFERENCES Building(BuildingID)          -- 1–N: FK on the N side
);
CREATE TABLE Manufacturer (
    ManufacturerID   int PRIMARY KEY,
    ManufacturerName nvarchar(100),
    Address          nvarchar(255)
);
CREATE TABLE Equipment (
    EquipmentID    int PRIMARY KEY,
    EquipmentName  nvarchar(100),
    Description    nvarchar(255),
    ManufacturerID int REFERENCES Manufacturer(ManufacturerID)
);
CREATE TABLE setup_Equi (                                       -- M–N with an attribute: its own table
    FloorID     int REFERENCES Floor(FloorID),
    EquipmentID int REFERENCES Equipment(EquipmentID),
    Quantity    int,
    PRIMARY KEY (FloorID, EquipmentID)
);
GO
-- Q8
CREATE PROCEDURE prNumberOfDepartments
    @countryID varchar(10),
    @numberOfDepartments int OUTPUT
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT @numberOfDepartments = COUNT(d.DepartmentID)
    FROM Departments d
    JOIN Locations l ON l.LocationID = d.LocationID
    WHERE l.CountryID = @countryID;
END
GO
-- Q9
CREATE TRIGGER Tr1 ON Employees
AFTER INSERT
AS
BEGIN
    SELECT i.EmployeeID, i.FirstName, i.LastName, i.DepartmentID, d.DepartmentName
    FROM inserted i                                              -- every inserted row, not just one
    JOIN Departments d ON d.DepartmentID = i.DepartmentID;
END
